SSL Decryption Bypass List

This repository provides an automated, community-curated, minimal SSL/TLS decryption bypass FQDN list for enterprise firewalls. The list is generated nightly.

Available Endpoint

  • FQDN List: /ssl-bypass-fqdn.txt

Usage Guidelines

  • Fetch Frequency: Configure your firewall or external dynamic list (EDL) to fetch this file no more than once per hour (every 60 minutes).
  • Caching: This file is served globally via Cloudflare CDN for maximum availability.

Powered by GitHub Actions & Cloudflare Pages.
